The thing is, I don't even know where to start. Everything is fine but also nothing is fine. I've been staring at this for three hours and the more I look, the less sense it makes.

Honestly, I don't know if the problem is the code or me at this point. I read the docs — the docs said one thing, the code does another, and there's a comment in the code that contradicts both. Who wrote this and why does it exist?

Also, why does it work? According to everything I know, it should not work. And yet it works fine in production and fails in tests, which is the opposite of what should happen. I need someone to explain this in simple words, because I've clearly lost the ability to understand anything.
